entries.headline: Boeing E-4B ADFEB5 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing E-4B with registration 74-0787 and hex ADFEB5, with no callsign listed, citing a sighting by gamermodeflex and a photo by Chris Lofting via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: EAM header code 56F5M4 reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble carrying the code 56F5M4.

entries.headline: Three USAF radio broadcasts and four transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported three coded US Air Force radio broadcasts detected during the previous hour while four military transport aircraft were airborne over the United States simultaneously.

entries.headline: EAM header code 56FTM4 reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble carrying the code 56FTM4.

entries.headline: C-32A AF1 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing C-32A using callsign AF1, registration 19-0018 and hex AE4AEC, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Brian Stewart via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Five USAF cargo aircraft, surveillance drone and radio broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five US Air Force cargo aircraft airborne over the continental United States alongside a surveillance drone, with one coded military radio broadcast heard during the hour.

entries.headline: Clashes involving Houthi and tribal forces reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported heavy clashes between Ansar Allah (Houthi) forces and local tribal fighters backed by the Nation's Shield Forces, with reporting credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: USAF Boeing 747-8 SAM01 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a US Air Force Boeing 747-8 assigned to the 89th Airlift Wing at Andrews Air Force Base, using callsign SAM01, registration 25-3300 and hex AF83F3, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Josh M via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: WC-135R AE037F spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing WC-135R with registration 64-14829 and hex AE037F, broadcasting no callsign, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Nikoli Sparkes via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Report says Houthis seek more Chinese missile supplies
entries.summary: War Watch shared an Associated Press report that Yemen's Houthis are seeking additional Chinese supplies to build ballistic missiles, with reporting credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: NATO annual nuclear exercise begins in Italy, report says
entries.summary: War Watch shared a Stars and Stripes report that NATO had begun its annual nuclear exercise in Italy, with reporting credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: E-6 Mercury AED86B spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing E-6 Mercury with hex AED86B and no callsign displayed, citing a sighting by reagan0965.

entries.headline: Stratolaunch 747 carrying unseen rocket reported

entries.headline: F-35C arrested landing aboard future USS John F. Kennedy reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a TWZ report that an F-35C completed the first arrested landing aboard the future USS John F. Kennedy, a Ford-class aircraft carrier.
